scientific_integrity: All general assertions follow from explicit polynomial localizations and monomial primary intersections; finite symbolic checks supplement rather than replace the proof. Historical equivalence risk acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic zero and only the hollow symmetric 4-by-4 quartic; no full classification of all analytic hypersurface germs at component crossings and no n>=5 extension. Earlier sources provide the quartic equation and reduced singular support.
title: Reduced Jacobian scheme and tetrahedral vertex germs of the hollow quartic
